end.summary: Discussed how harvest festivals relate to crops being ready or harvested.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting harvest festivals with crops becoming ready and being cut. They explained that people feel thankful and happy after a good harvest. They mixed up the role of seasons and said festival dates are random; this was not fully corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, look at a simple crop calendar and ask which season each crop is harvested in.
